logic.rationale: Trail exit. The discretionary rule is to exit on a regular-session close below 184.5 (raised from 182 on 11/13). XLV closed at 181.18 on 11/18, 1.8% below the line, so this is not a marginal breach. The day's low was 180.74, under the 11/6 hammer low of 181.14, on 10.4M shares, the heaviest volume since the 11/5 flush. The cause was the CMS Medicare Advantage audit proposal: managed care fell 5-13% and health care was the worst sector on 11/18 (-2.2%). §3 allows exits already triggered by a close to be submitted at the first run after that close. XLV has no extended session, so this executes at the 11/19 open. On the 11/18 marks this lot is +$74.20 (+4.6%); SPY is about -5% over the same window.

The breakout add closes with tranche 1 on the same trail trigger: the 11/18 regular close of 181.18 is below the 184.5 line. It executes at the 11/19 open. On the 11/18 marks it is +$6.07 (+1.7%), above its 178.09 entry because the trail was ratcheted before the policy shock.
